candidates.term: The Steward inside the Hour Gate
candidates.defline: The Steward lives inside your Hour Gate: underneath your later years sits a quiet habit of keeping everything provided for.
candidates.reading: In later life you want things settled, with savings kept, care arranged and nothing left to chance. Because providing is how you love, you make arrangements for others long before they are needed, and you keep your own sleep and meals in the same good order. Those who come after you, children or younger relatives or someone you train, learn thrift by watching you. Your hardest task in these years is enjoying what you have secured, and you come to it slowly.
candidates.teaser: Security deepens with age: the root of your late years is provision done right. Children learn thrift from you, and your estate lands where you intend it.

domain_readings.Family: Your late family rests on your provision: the root of the last decades is a household squared away, heirs taught thrift by demonstration, care funded before it is needed. Narrate the choices occasionally. The lesson outlasts the money, and it cannot be misspent.
domain_readings.Health: Your late health answers to stewardship: maintenance over heroics, checkups kept like appointments with yourself, moderation without misery. The body rewards the ledger-keeper’s patience. Tend it the way you tend accounts, regularly, and it funds a long retirement.
domain_readings.Wealth: Money finishes stable here: the estate lands where you point it, the household never feels the weather, and the floor holds. The discipline built it. Now spend some comfort on yourself deliberately. You will have earned it twice over by then.

candidates.life_chapter: Your late chapter is provisioned ground: the last decades run on reserves built early and kept honestly, a household that never feels the weather. Expect calm where others meet turbulence. The era’s one assignment is learning to enjoy what you secured.
candidates.relations: The provided-for are this seat’s people: children, grandchildren, the household that rests on your quiet arrangements. They may never see the work, only the warmth. Show a little of the work. Gratitude needs a ledger to read.
candidates.turn_catalyst: Run thin, the provisioning starts late: floors thinner than the plan. Begin the standing transfer today. Late compounding still compounds.
candidates.turn_friction: Run heavy, the reserves outrank the living: comfort deferred in its own decade. Book the trip. The estate approves.
candidates.shadow_line: Overloaded, provision becomes the last word: love spoken only through arrangements.
candidates.health_line: Your late body keeps what you maintained: steady walks, kept appointments, honest portions. It ages like a well-serviced engine, gradually and without drama.

Family.headline: Your family rests on what you quietly arrange.
Family.recognition: You keep your family covered, the bills paid and the plans made for whoever needs them. Because care for you means provision, you say almost nothing about what you have arranged. You prefer it when your family sees the calm and not the work behind it.
Family.lived: In your Late Chapter you have kept a steady store for your family, quietly topped up and ready before anyone asks. You have shown the people after you how to be careful with money mostly by example, and they have spent more wisely for it.
Family.ahead: From your late forties the people after you build their own lives on what you have saved and set aside for them. You are the steady keeper behind them, and they learn only later how much of their footing you paid for.

Health.headline: Your body does best on steady upkeep.
Health.recognition: Your body gets the same care as your accounts, with regular walks, plain food and early nights. Because routine is what keeps you feeling safe, small daily care suits you better than any sudden effort. You catch the first sign of tiredness early and spend your energy as carefully as your money.
Health.lived: In your Late Chapter your energy has held steady, because you kept your sleep and your habits in good order. You have more of it in reserve than people who spent theirs freely, and that reserve has been worth every early night.
Health.ahead: From your late forties your body repays the care you keep giving it, with steady energy and regular sleep. You outlast people who run themselves down, and every ordinary habit turns out to have been worth its cost.

Wealth.headline: Your money ends up settled and secure.
Wealth.recognition: You keep reserves for every possible need, and a full account calms you more than any purchase. Because security is what you work for, you spend on others easily and on yourself with reluctance. You have more put by than you let yourself spend.
Wealth.lived: In your Late Chapter your finances have settled, and your household has felt the hard times around it less than most. You built your savings slowly and kept them whole through every lean year, and they have become the fund your household falls back on.
Wealth.ahead: From your late forties your money stays steady while others worry, and your plans for it land where you intend. You find that part of what you saved was always meant for you, and spending it on yourself stops feeling like a loss.
